mapper.delete: with recursive comment_tree as( select id from comment where id = #{id} union all select c.id from comment c join comment_tree ct on c.parent_id = ct.id ) delete from comment where id in (select id from comment_tree)
mapper.select: select c.id, c.content, c.create_time, c.user_id, c.blog_id, c.parent_id, c.likes, c.dislikes, c.status, u.username as username, u.avatar as user_avatar from comment c left join user u on c.user_id = u.id where c.id = #{id}
